consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1987-03-03 show at the Kaiser Convention Center had a unique setlist and high energy, with standout moments in songs like 'Quinn the Eskimo' and 'Iko Iko.' While some reviewers criticized Jerry's performance, many appreciated the overall vibe and sound quality of the recording.
